changeRationale: Retain v1 as the normative operand base and v2/v3 as rejected provenance; preserve v3's mapping-specific exact-definition separation; add closed empirical-publication, exact-authority, local-lineage, and project-selection universes; bind every active project selection/intervention record as inspectable arm support; restore the exact generatedFrom hash domain; and make all promotion clauses independently derived per arm.

edgeEvidenceClassRules.disclosed-nonsupport: A legacy rows[].sourceNodeIds union member that does not support this data family. It cannot satisfy, exempt, block, or otherwise alter an independence obligation.
edgeEvidenceClassRules.inspectable-lineage-required: This edge carries empirical, model, selection, local-derivation, or project-record lineage. Missing, unreadable, unreviewed, or hash-mismatched required bytes force the affected active arm's empirical-independence verdict to unresolved.
edgeEvidenceClassRules.shared-exact-definition: This edge carries only a universal exact definition. It does not count as empirical held-out overlap and does not require local bytes for empirical independence, but it must bind one or more authorityEvidenceDescriptorIds whose authority/provenance and currency obligations independently gate overall promotion.

rows.overlapRule: Reuse of the candidate data to infer or select the attachment-coefficient-HK law or supersaturation definition is overlap; a citation without data reuse is not.
Reuse of candidate measurements to fit the saturation-density or temperature mapping is overlap; use of the published law as a common physical definition is disclosed but not by itself overlap.
Candidate data used to fit kinetic-speed or ice-number-density inputs is overlap; shared authoritative exact definitions are disclosed shared inputs, not empirical-data overlap.
Candidate transport measurements used to fit D_air or its pressure scaling are overlap; the exact atmosphere definition is disclosed but not empirical-data overlap.

Candidate data used for any active water-supersaturation anchor or interpolation choice are overlap; if the eventual protocol does not use this quantity it requires a reviewed catalog revision marking the row inactive.
Exact unit conversion is a disclosed shared definition; only candidate-derived calibration of a conversion or offset is overlap.
These values inherit every source family of their operands; treating the derived values as new independent data is invalid.
Reuse of Figure 4.5 basal anchors, their underlying broad-facet measurements, or a candidate-derived selection among them is overlap. Unresolved transitive contributors force unresolved.
Reuse of Figure 4.5 prism anchors, their underlying broad-facet measurements, or a candidate-derived selection among them is overlap. Unresolved transitive contributors force unresolved.
Reuse of the basal prefactor anchors or their unresolved underlying measurement lineage is overlap or unresolved respectively.
Reuse of the prism prefactor anchors or their unresolved underlying measurement lineage is overlap or unresolved respectively.
Candidate data used to choose interpolation, extrapolation, or admissible temperature domain are overlap; project-only choices with no candidate use are disclosed but independent.
Reuse of the TAX2 broad-basal formula inputs or their measurement lineage is overlap.
Reuse of the TAX2 broad-prism formula inputs or their measurement lineage is overlap.
Reuse of candidate data to choose unity prefactors is overlap; source-stated simplification without candidate reuse is not.
Any candidate data, habit category, apparatus series, or derived observable used to select basal dip depth, centre, width, or arm inclusion is overlap.
Any candidate data, habit category, apparatus series, or derived observable used to select prism dip depth, centre, width, or arm inclusion is overlap.
Candidate data used to choose the logarithm interpretation are overlap; the present source support is qualitative, so a claimed quantitative width validation remains unresolved.
Candidate data used to select the active magnitude/temperature domain are overlap; exact percent conversion alone is not.
The no-dip arm exactly inherits M1 broad-basal provenance; any overlap or unresolved lineage transfers unchanged.
The no-dip arm exactly inherits M1 broad-prism provenance; any overlap or unresolved lineage transfers unchanged.
The no-dip arm inherits M1 prefactor and domain provenance; only the dip intervention changes.

The numerical multiplier is a project intervention equal to one, but M1 basal-dip and Nakaya data remain removed/counterfactual selection lineage; candidate reuse in arm selection is overlap and unresolved selection lineage is unresolved.

The numerical multiplier is a project intervention equal to one, but M1 prism-dip and Nakaya data remain removed/counterfactual selection lineage; candidate reuse in arm selection is overlap and unresolved selection lineage is unresolved.
Inactive diagnostic/material quantities require a reviewed catalog revision before any validation protocol may consume them.
Closed-form water/thermal/spherical diagnostics are nonoperative; activation requires physics/specification review and a catalog revision.
FACET/M2 width feedback and related closures are not M1 or no-dip operands; activation requires a reviewed catalog revision.
Historical scoring exclusions and brackets are not inherited into R15; a successor scoring freeze must activate separately cataloged rows if it uses them.

catalogResultPromotionRule.armScopedOverlapRule: Empirical or project-selection overlap affects only the arm whose operand/support record is implicated. Candidate-global source invalidity is evaluated separately by the search registry and cannot be inferred from another arm's overlap.
catalogResultPromotionRule.separationInvariant: Each component remains separately reportable. Exact-definition authority/currentness and local byte integrity never change empirical independence, while any unresolved or failed component blocks overall promotion.

catalogInvariants.closedWorldSupportMapping: Every rows[].operandId/dataFamilyIds[] pair occurs exactly once in dataFamilySupport. Only listed sourceSupport edges support that data family; no node-wide evidence class or exemption exists.
catalogInvariants.edgeClassClosure: Every sourceSupport edge names a sourceNodes entry. shared-exact-definition edges must bind nonempty authorityEvidenceDescriptorIds whose descriptors name the same sourceNodeId and explicitly include that operandId/dataFamilyId in coveredSupportPairs; other edge classes must not bind authorityEvidenceDescriptorIds.
catalogInvariants.generatedFromCanonicalization: For each generatedFrom path, enforce generatedFromHashDomain exactly: repository-root-relative regular file at that path; reject aliases, symlinks, junctions and reparse substitution; strict UTF-8 with no BOM, malformed bytes or lone carriage returns; convert only CRLF pairs to LF; perform no Unicode normalization; preserve terminal-LF presence; SHA-256 the resulting bytes.
catalogInvariants.legacyRowUnionRule: For dataFamilySupport only, each row's mapped sourceNodeIds remains a subset of the unchanged v1 rows[].sourceNodeIds and disclosed-nonsupport has no evidentiary role. projectSelectionSupport is an explicitly separate successor provenance universe and must not be rejected by, merged into, or used to bypass this legacy source-node rule.
catalogInvariants.membershipRule: sourceNodeMemberships is a disjoint exhaustive partition of sourceNodes. active-support means at least one non-disclosed edge on an active row; inactive-only-support means at least one non-disclosed edge and none on an active row; unreferenced-context-only means no non-disclosed edge and is forbidden from affecting an active proof.
catalogInvariants.sourceNatureRule: A shared-exact-definition-authority node may have only shared-exact-definition or disclosed-nonsupport edges and every shared-exact-definition edge must satisfy edgeClassClosure. All empirical, model-publication, local-derived-evidence, and project-record natures are forbidden from conferring an exact-definition exemption; their supporting edges must be inspectable-lineage-required.
catalogInvariants.rowActivationRule: Only rows with active=true participate in the current empirical-independence reduction. Activating any inactive row or any unreferenced-context-only node requires a reviewed successor catalog.
catalogInvariants.projectSelectionClosure: Every projectSelectionSupport path/hash exactly matches one generatedFrom member; IDs, paths, and hashes are unique; affected arms exist; affected operands are active members of every named arm or of ALL; affected data families occur on those operands; every active P3/P4, project-closure, selection, or intervention row is covered; each affected arm receives an independent candidate-comparison disposition for every required record.
catalogInvariants.currencyUniverseClosure: Recompute all three currencySubjectUniverses from active mapping edges, authority descriptors, local nodes, and project-selection records. The universes are disjoint by role, exhaustive under their derivations, and feed different promotion fields.
catalogInvariants.reviewFindingClosure: reviewFindingRegistry.requiredFindingIds is unique and sorted by UTF-16 code-unit order; every ID exists exactly once in the governed review-finding record and no producer-authored disposition can count as review acceptance.

supersedesRejectedCandidates.relationToSuccessor: historical rejected candidate retained byte-exact; no field is inherited by implication

reviewFindingRegistry.statusRule: This catalog is an author correction candidate. A finding record may describe the response, but only a later exact-byte non-author review can close it. Missing, duplicate, or noncanonical required IDs block catalog acceptance.

generatedFromHashDomain.pathDomain: repository-root-relative path naming one regular file at that exact path
generatedFromHashDomain.pathAliasRule: reject a symlink, junction, reparse-point target substitution, case alias, alternate relative spelling, or any resolved-path substitution
generatedFromHashDomain.decoding: strict UTF-8; reject BOM, malformed UTF-8, and every lone carriage-return byte
generatedFromHashDomain.lineEndings: replace each exact CRLF byte pair with one LF byte
generatedFromHashDomain.terminalNewline: preserve exact presence or absence of the terminal LF after CRLF conversion
generatedFromHashDomain.freezeRule: every path and digest must reopen and match at the combined committed freeze
